learningGoal: Help Ila use a calm visual stamp model to see that flat sides leave prints and curved surfaces roll away.
misconception: A curved surface can act like a flat face.

sourceEvidence.summary: Homework asks the child to identify flat faces of three-dimensional shapes.

display.title: Tiny Stamp Garden
display.subtitle: One gentle stamp at a time: flat makes a print, round rolls away.

engagementWrapper.label: Calm Visual Coach
engagementWrapper.promptLanguage: Make it warm, cute, concrete, and visual anchor first. Use single-step language, tiny garden imagery, and gentle confidence instead of speed or pressure.

assumptions: Ila may benefit from visual support before independent retrieval because prior chart notes show stronger performance when concepts are anchored on the canvas.
A calm, cute stamp garden may reduce cognitive load while keeping the geometry concrete.
The explainer should use one clear idea at a time before the co-op recall game checks whether the model transferred.
falsifyCriteria: Ila requests a break or shows frustration during the prediction pause
delayed concept-check or homework evidence shows she still treats curved surfaces as flat faces

researchNotes.summary: Visual representations can make abstract math concepts concrete for intervention.
Follow the visual model with feedback-rich recall rather than treating watching as mastery.

reuseDecision.reason: Personalization demo for Ila using the cached solid-faces visual without spending generation credits.

parentApproval.notes: Review whether the calm visual wrapper feels appropriate for Ila before regenerating a bespoke version.

timings.text: Tiny shapes are visiting the stamp garden.
A flat side can press down and make a print.
The stamp pad only works when a flat side touches it.
Which shape rolls away because it has no flat side?
The sphere is all curve, so it rolls instead of stamping.
Flat makes a face. Curved makes a roll.

questions.prompt: Which shape rolls away because it has no flat side to press?

companionContext.hintText: Look for the one shape that cannot press one flat side onto the stamp pad.

hintsByPhase.intro: Watch one shape at a time.
hintsByPhase.rotate: Ask: can one side touch the pad flat?
hintsByPhase.stamp: Flat sides make quiet little prints.
hintsByPhase.prediction: One shape is all round, with no flat side.
hintsByPhase.reveal: Compare the print to the side that touched the pad.
hintsByPhase.review: Flat makes a print. Curved rolls.

questions.prompt: Which solid can make a square print?
Which shape has no flat face for the stamp pad?
Which solids can make a circle print with a flat base?
